question: How does descriptive separation between the same frozen secretion sources change across predeclared synthetic initial gastric loads?

sources.order: declared list order, sequential supervised source execution
sources.paths: regular local files; relative paths resolve against config directory; metadata checking never imports source

scenarios.type: ordered nonempty subset of distinct supported fixed scenario IDs

timeout_seconds.scope: per numerical/reference stage; reference generation and its repeats are separately supervised

source_timeout_seconds.scope: entire source across every selected load, numerical/refinement stage, observation stage, fresh-process repeats and verification; never reset per load or stage

configuration.unsupported: Reject extra keys, repeated/unknown scenarios, arbitrary load/timing/profile/horizon/grid/unit/runtime/state settings before callback execution

conditions.initial_load_semantics: Only native initial x[0] and last_Qsto equal the selected gastric solid mg; last_foodtaken=0 and Action.CHO=0 throughout; not an announced meal, bolus, controller or timed intervention

basal_replacement.not_a_claim: replacement fraction is a prescribed experiment design; no estimate of insulin need or functional cell fraction

conditions.fixed_sc_schedule: unchanged 75% native SC basal throughout; no candidate/controller override

native_boundary.glucose_rate: native dx[3]/Vg at the same RHS evaluation
native_boundary.liver_input: S=gamma*P added to guarded dx[9] only
native_boundary.portal_egp_term: not added; native has no direct portal insulin action
native_boundary.cpeptide: excluded from first feedback experiment; no implicit reuse of insulin transit

conditions.freeze: Raw config/model/declaration bytes and hashes, numeric source parameters, this protocol, guidance, all implementation/helper source inventory and numerical project/lock bytes archived before supplied callback execution; changed identities reject dispatch

units.liver: host-owned S=gamma*P into guarded native liver state only
units.basal: host-owned BC-008 fraction 0.25 SC replacement and matched plasma insulin
units.causality: only current time, native same-stage G and Gdot, current Z, Sb, h and declared numeric parameters
units.model_purity: no mutable hidden state or future glucose; adaptive solver may evaluate time repeatedly or out of order

source_contract.preflight: unchanged M4-CAUSAL/1 equilibrium and repeated out-of-order evaluation checks; a hash or these probes do not prove arbitrary callback purity or biological applicability

reference.historical_baseline: Generate or use internally retained unchanged complete BC-008/2 archive; verify original source analytic checks, native preflight, full archive/runtime/source identities and reconstruction before new scenario solves
reference.native_zero: fraction=0, gain=0, original native state and original SC basal; also zero-extension/padded same-solver check and unmodified native class diagnostic
reference.host_constant_basal: fraction=0.25, gain=0 with matched plasma insulin, basal liver inventory/SC depots, Z=Sb and P=Sb/gamma; independent original feedback equations
reference.bc008_reference: fraction=0.25, gain=1 using original BC-008 feedback equations, newly solved for every selected initial load
reference.identity: The same scenario-specific controls/reference identity is supplied to each source. A reference from another load or altered initial/basal/grid/locks cannot support comparison
reference.historical_anchor_parity: For selected fasting/30g, compare original BC-008 native_zero/constant_basal/feedback_full tight/reference and native diagnostics against new same-equation/same-solver runs; maximum numeric discrepancy must be zero. Coarse is a new refined setting and has no byte-parity claim against original0.5min setting.

numerical.integration: monolithic native+Z+P+ledgers; no sensor derivative, finite-difference glucose or sequential stale feedback; same-state derivative has no instantaneous dependence on S

refinement.solver: Both coarse-versus-reference and tight-versus-reference must meet frozen glucose, insulin and source tolerances; every solver preserves complete-grid/conservation/domain evidence
refinement.replay: Archive liver-arrival from dense reference source and replay with unchanged independent original feedback forcing integrator, piecewise linear split at knots; fine replay glucose/insulin closure required for each active reference and candidate
refinement.source_sampling_limit: Observer uses archived 0.25min pancreatic source; coarsening is not continuous-source convergence below this grid

numerical.inventory: 20 state columns: native0..12,Z,P and integrated SC/pancreatic/liver-arrival/hepatic-loss/peripheral-loss; independent native glucose flux quadrature, exact initial and zero ledgers; do not use balance residual as flux definition
numerical.positivity: Same inherited physical states excluding signed native insulin-action index6; terminal envelope/negative-amount events; no clipping or shortened-run acceptance

cpeptide.locators: pp98-100 equimolar working assumption, process scheme and bolus response; p103 Table I nominal T1D means; inherited unchanged BC-003 implementation

boundary.baseline: total source already contains basal release; no additional basal or SC input
boundary.time: unchanged 0..240 elapsed min from parent stimulus, output every0.25min
boundary.transfer: continuous piecewise-linear interpolant of archived rate samples; no extrapolation
boundary.initial: Q1=Sb/k3; Q2=k1*Q1/k2; elimination and input ledgers zero
boundary.ownership: one-way observation; C-peptide owns distribution/removal; no insulin portal delay, HE factor, mass conversion or second body-weight division

observer.unit_chain: pancreatic appearance pmol/(kg min) -> central/peripheral amounts pmol/kg -> divide by volume L/kg -> central concentration pmol/L; no second body-weight conversion

diagnostics.sampling_scope: coarsening against the finest available parent grid, not proof of continuous-source convergence below0.25min
diagnostics.parent_solver: propagate tight parent Spo at0.25min and compare with reference parent Spo
diagnostics.wrong_boundary: post-portal liver arrival S; named fault comparator, never a valid observation inlet
diagnostics.scale_scope: scale only C-peptide appearance, both initial amounts and volume together; exact forward-observation ambiguity conditional on saved glucose/insulin, not a full coupled capacity transformation
diagnostics.outputs: C-peptide baseline, peak/time, final, signed AUC; concentration differences from wrong boundary, source-solver and sampling changes; scale ambiguity
diagnostics.fitting: none; no deconvolution, noise model, human identifiability claim or joint parameter recovery

observer.checks: Same passive two-solver matrix-exponential oracle, input/mass conservation, positivity, basal equilibrium, parent-tight propagation, 0.5/1-minute coarsening, liver-input fault and appearance/volume-scale ambiguity; no observer feedback or SC/hepatic/transit duplication

acceptance.source: Entire selected-load source workflow must complete and pass every numerical/refinement/observer/fresh-process repeat gate. A passing scenario prefix of a failed source is not accepted pair support
acceptance.reference: All selected scenario-specific native/control/feedback reference cases, diagnostics and repeats must pass before dependent accepted source comparisons
acceptance.repeat: All complete numeric case artifacts byte-identical in fresh worker processes; worker metadata equal after removing only primary/repeat label
acceptance.common_controls: Across accepted source children, exact complete scenario/grid/basal/native/runtime/control/reference equality; disagreement makes overall study fail and pair metrics null
acceptance.overall: Every frozen source/load cell and required control/reference must pass; preserve independent accepted pairs when another source fails but overall remains failed

comparison.support: every unordered source pair in roster order, all selected scenarios; both complete sources accepted and common conditions/controls verified
comparison.grid: all exact961 saved samples at0..240min; no shortening, resampling, dropping samples or interpolation between mismatched grids

metrics.signed_auc_difference: signed trapezoidal integral of left_i-right_i over complete240min; signal unit times min

comparison.interpretation: separate descriptive trajectory differences per load; no pooled ranking, winner, accuracy claim, tuning or required effect direction/magnitude

process_and_failures.ordinary_source_failure: retain all selected source/load cells and stage/error evidence; continue later frozen sources; partial trajectories remain diagnostic
process_and_failures.reference_failure: retain full source/load denominator with explicit dependent not_attempted/failed reasons; no accepted dependent pairs
process_and_failures.global_interruption: SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP cause owned numerical group termination and reaping before failure archive seal; later sources not_attempted
process_and_failures.deadline: finite stage plus entire-source budgets; kill/reap owned numerical sessions; caller campaign deadline remains separate and never rewrites native settings
process_and_failures.output: fresh nonoverlapping directory; no symlink inputs/archive entries; never rewrite historical archives; do not silently discard failed/unattempted cells

archive_and_reconstruction.reader: standard-library report.reconstruct(archive,write_to=None,allow_failed=False); verify every archived file identity, frozen config/source/protocol/runtime/helper binding, state/roster, numerical semantics, controls/grid, repeats and contrast arithmetic before writing a fresh output
archive_and_reconstruction.saved_reports: Existing saved derived bytes must match recomputed reports; output must be fresh/separate; no silent repair of altered reports
archive_and_reconstruction.failed_archive: explicit --allow-failed preserves passed=false, full planned denominators, unattempted/failed/missing-evidence reasons and null unsupported pairs
archive_and_reconstruction.limit: Artifact reconstruction establishes archive/report consistency; does not import or replay callback, require original external source paths, independently reproduce arbitrary model execution or establish rights/model validity

internal_verification.native_example: both existing Dalla Man adapter and ultradian response component, all three loads, all numerical gates and exact fresh-process repeats
internal_verification.historical_candidate_parity: Separate required acceptance evidence comparing fasting/30g candidate/control and observer numeric outputs from unchanged M4-RESEARCHER/1 against new same-source/same-solver outputs for both example structures; does not inject unselected scenarios into user configurations
internal_verification.negative: invalid/unsupported config refusal before callback execution; failing source retains roster and accepted independent support; shortened/mismatched/tampered evidence rejects; deadline/interruption process cleanup and failed reconstruction
internal_verification.repository: locked tooling sync/check plus appropriate locked numerical tests; record only checks actually completed, revisions/hashes/commands and remaining limits in separate execution receipt
